metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Controlled rule-consistency benchmark. Does NOT claim human learning effectiveness.

report.title: Controlled Recommendation Rule-Consistency Evaluation
report.research_question: RQ-REC: Does the Phase 7B recommendation engine consistently enforce pedagogical action selection, multi-signal prioritization, and student isolation across controlled synthetic scenarios?
report.hypothesis: The deterministic recommendation engine adheres to 100% of defined pedagogical action rules, prioritization invariants, and student isolation boundaries under controlled test conditions.
report.procedure: Executed 10 controlled scenarios across high-confidence weakness, uncertainty, prerequisite deficit, downstream blockers, assessment gap, recent-action damping, mastered deprioritization, cold start, student isolation, and determinism.
report.interpretation: The recommendation engine strictly adheres to defined pedagogical rules under controlled conditions. Action selection and reason codes accurately reflect underlying knowledge states and graph dependencies.
scientific_claims: The recommendation engine reliably prioritizes weak concepts, handles unmastered prerequisites, avoids repetitive actions, and maintains deterministic student isolation under controlled simulated conditions.
limitations: Evaluated strictly on controlled synthetic scenarios, not live student cohort trajectories.
Does not establish student learning gains, retention, or cognitive-load reduction.
Recommender weights remain heuristic and require future empirical tuning.
